messages:
Mia (Mktg PM): quick sync — planning a small pricing page microtest. Goals: clarify FAQ for common buying scenarios, try two different tier-name sets, and experiment with calculator placement + webinar CTA. Need routing rules for leads from the calc. Thoughts?
Sam (Growth): SGTM. Can we also surface a simple benchmark stat in the hero (cost/1k tokens vs self-host) so the calc feels grounded?
Jordan (Sales AE): For routing, propose: estimate >= $5k/mo -> route to Sales via Intercom + tag 'high-commitment-calc'. Below that -> automated nurture + webinar invite.
Eli (Content): I'll draft scenario-first FAQ (e.g., "I have latency-sensitive real-time chat" / "I need on-prem for compliance"). For tier names, quick idea: 'Developer, Production, Managed'. Different from current labels — keeps function explicit.
Lana (Design): UX note — if we make the calc sticky in the header it must be collapsible on mobile. Also want a small 'commitment badge' area (discounts for reserved capacity) so estimates don't scare users off.
Mia (Mktg PM): Proposed variants: A = current page + calc at bottom; B = scenario FAQ cards + sticky mini-calc in header + webinar CTA modal. Test length: 2 weeks. Primary metrics: calc engagement %, signups from calc, qualified-lead count. Secondary: webinar RSVPs. Need experiment key and tracking plan. @product-bot can you create the exp id?
product-bot: Experiment key created: exp_pricing_microtest_2124001234
Sam (Growth): Nice. A couple questions on tracking — what UTM scheme for webinar CTA (live vs on-demand)? Also want GA events from calc interactions (estimate_submit, estimate_change).
Mia (Mktg PM): Use utm_campaign=pricing_microtest, utm_content=webinar_live or webinar_on_demand. GA events: calc_open, calc_submit, calc_return. Sam please add those to the spec and the data layer.
Jordan (Sales AE): Also add Intercom attributes: estimated_monthly_value, interest_private_deploy (boolean). Playbook: trigger Sales ping for estimated_monthly_value >= 5000 or interest_private_deploy == true.
Eli (Content): Draft FAQ snippet to start:
```FAQ: My app is latency-sensitive — which plan is right for me?
Answer: For low tail-latency and predictable SLAs, start on 'Production' (hosted). If you need sustained throughput or data isolation, move to Dedicated or Private with reserved capacity. Contact Sales for capacity planning.
```
Lana (Design): Will mock the sticky calc (desktop + collapsed mobile) by Monday. Will also add a small badge UI for 'Reserved discount' next to estimates.
Mia (Mktg PM): Action items:
- Eli: first FAQ draft by Tue
- Sam: tracking + UTM + GA events by Tue
- Jordan: Intercom routing + playbooks by Wed
- Lana: mobile + desktop mocks by Mon
- product-bot/Product: confirm experiment rollout plan (canary vs full) and tagging
I'll put the experiment spec in docs and link it here when ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/experiments/pricing-microtest-2124001234
Sam (Growth): :thumbsup:
Jordan (Sales AE): keeping here for visibility — will coordinate handoff once leads start coming in.
